about: The class doors' manners and the first visits, 1897 (Magic's req 2825, Story's settled 233): a class door is a polite door until Clementine has taken the boy there once, per boy, in his own year, then it is his for good. Variable cd_<class> = met, kept per boy in his own castle year; the books' castles' prefect words are Nineties', so every record reads era = 1890s. Provisional: the doors' places and tap ids until the Architect names each class's door; the offer sets clem_walk = <class> (Magic's gate, row 2822) when Clementine's walk is on its way to that door, and the tap on it is the first visit and `tried <door>` when his Alohomora answers nothing. Wednesday afternoon's History of Magic slot is not here (Events, open).
